items.title: Israel intensifies South Lebanon strikes, killing 13 after weeks-long lull

items.title: Eiffel Tower workers go on strike after female staff 'sidelined' for Hindu group's visit
items.standfirst: The Eiffel Tower was forced to close on Monday after staff went on strike to protest the "sidelining" and "replacement" of female employees during a recent visit by a Hindu delegation. The Paris landmark's operator said the group had requested that the private visit be organised in such a way as to limit "interactions with women".
